tools.name: look_up_word
tools.description: Find a Chinese word from its characters, its pinyin (with tone marks, tone numbers or none) or a meaning in English, Spanish, Indonesian, Thai or Vietnamese. Covers the 4,999 words of HSK 1-6. Answers with the word's pinyin, meaning, HSK level and HSK 3.0 band, the meaning and stroke count of each c

tools.name: stroke_data
tools.description: Stroke data for the characters on Talkhao's word card, for the card to draw them stroke by stroke.

tools.name: hsk_words
tools.description: What is in an HSK list: an HSK level (1-6), an HSK 3.0 band (1-6 or 7-9) or a topic (numbers, food and drink, family, ...). Answers with the number of words, the first five with their pinyin and meaning, the list's Talkhao page and its practice link; when the learner's account is connected, each wor

tools.name: my_progress
tools.description: The signed-in learner's Talkhao progress by HSK level: words learned, words being learned, words not started and reviews due today. Give one HSK level (1-6), or none for the learner's own level and every level they have started. Needs the learner's Talkhao account connected.

tools.name: save_words
tools.description: Save HSK words to the signed-in learner's Talkhao sets, so they come up in practice. Give the words in Chinese characters, up to 20. Supports bracketed headwords (e.g. 花（名词）, 长（动词）) to disambiguate readings. Needs the learner's Talkhao account connected.
